items.title: 想行动前，先判断这一步是清楚还是慌乱
items.hook: 如果下一步来自慌乱，先暂停。
items.body: 把想做的事写下来：是表达、求证，还是想马上不难受？先分清动机，再决定。
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no pressure tactic

items.title: 边界不是惩罚，是你保持诚实的方式
items.hook: 你可以很在意，也可以不追着证明自己。
items.body: 好的边界不是让对方输，而是让你不把自己丢掉。
items.cta: 得到一个更稳的下一步
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no manipulation advice

items.title: 别和慌乱谈判
items.hook: 慌乱要的是立刻证明，清楚要的是关系模式。
items.body: 如果你只想马上得到一个答复，先不要把它包装成必须解决的问题。
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no diagnosis

items.title: 要发消息就发一句干净的话
items.hook: 说真实，不试探；表达，不逼答案。
items.body: 把指责、试探和求稳定感的部分删掉，留下一句可以承担后果的真话。
items.cta: 问清楚这句话背后的问题
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no guaranteed reply

items.title: 你的下一步也要把自己放进去
items.hook: 不要为了一个答案，把自己的平静全部押上。
items.body: 行动之前先问：这一步会让我更像自己，还是更害怕失去？
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no outcome guarantee

items.title: Pause before the next step
items.hook: If the next step comes from panic, pause first.
items.body: 15 second script: hand over send button, timer, then write one calm boundary question.
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no pressure tactic

items.title: Boundary is not punishment
items.hook: A boundary is how you stay honest without chasing.
items.body: 20 second script: two columns, what I feel and what I will do next; frame Tianji as a private reflection tool.
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no manipulation advice

items.title: Do not negotiate with panic
items.hook: Panic wants proof. Clarity wants a pattern.
items.body: 15 second script: replay loop, breath, then pattern map.
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no diagnosis

items.title: One clean sentence
items.hook: If you choose to speak, make it clean and kind.
items.body: 20 second script: rewrite a messy message into one clear sentence with no demand for reassurance.
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no guaranteed response

items.title: Keep yourself in the frame
items.hook: The next move should include you, not only them.
items.body: 15 second script: zoom from their reply to your sleep, focus, and boundary.
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no outcome guarantee

items.title: Boundary before action
items.hook: If the next step comes from panic, pause first.
items.body: Short post: You can care deeply and still refuse to make your nervous system the project manager.
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no pressure advice

items.title: A cleaner message
items.hook: A clean message says what is true without begging for stability.
items.body: Short post: Before sending, remove accusation, remove testing, keep one honest sentence.
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no fake metric

items.title: Not every pause is a game
items.hook: A pause can be care for yourself, not strategy against someone else.
items.body: Short post: Boundaries are not punishments. They are how you keep your shape.
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no manipulation framing

items.title: Pattern over impulse
items.hook: Impulse asks for relief. Pattern asks for truth.
items.body: Short post: If you are about to act from fear, zoom out one level first.
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no certainty claim

items.title: Your next move should protect you too
items.hook: Do not make a next move that erases your own peace.
items.body: Short post: Clarity is not about controlling their answer. It is about choosing your posture.
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no outcome guarantee

items.title: How do I set a boundary without pushing them away?
items.hook: A boundary is not a threat if it is honest and specific.
items.body: Answer draft: Suggest naming what you can do, not forcing what they must do. Avoid promising their reaction. Disclose Tianji Love if linking.
items.notes: Manual posting only; disclose affiliation if used

items.title: Should I send another message?
items.hook: Check whether the message is clarity or reassurance seeking.
items.body: Answer draft: Offer a three-part check: intention, timing, willingness to accept no response. Disclose affiliation if linking.
items.notes: Manual posting only; no response guarantee

items.title: How do I stop acting from anxiety?
items.hook: Slow the action down until you can hear the real question.
items.body: Answer draft: Encourage writing the one question underneath the impulse and choosing a calmer next step. Disclose affiliation if linking.
items.notes: Manual posting only; no therapeutic claim
